less than 1 MB/s

span.p:
100 MB/s – 1 GB/s
→ CDN mandatory
multi-region edge

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 GB/s+
→ P2P or chunked delivery
e.g. BitTorrent protocol

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
less than 1k writes/s
→ Direct DB write

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1k–10k writes/s
→ Batch writes or
write-behind cache

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10k+ writes/s
→ Kafka queue in front
workers drain to DB

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
less than 100 GB
→ Single Postgres node

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10 TB – 100 TB
→ Shard Postgres
or DynamoDB/Cassandra

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
less than 1k req/s
→ Single server + single DB

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1k–10k req/s
→ Load balancer + 2-3 servers
+ Redis cache

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10k–100k req/s
→ Horizontal scale + CDN
+ Read replicas

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
100k+ req/s
→ Sharding + multiple caches
+ Queue in front
